about: Surf Sanctuary is a surf and ocean adventure school set up in 2014 and based at the Headland Hotel, overlooking Fistral Beach in Newquay. Surf breaks, sheltered coves and snorkelling and SUP routes are all within walking distance. It coaches surfers from beginner to advanced and runs a wide range of other sea activities.
offers: Family, advanced and bespoke surf lessons
Ocean confidence and Foil Drive training
where: Headland Hotel, Headland Road, Newquay (TR7 1EW), on Fistral Beach
goodToKnow: Book online, by phone or by email
Licensed by the Adventure Activities Licensing Authority (AALA, R2982)
gaps: No season, inclusions, what to bring or cancellation terms
